text:
Aisha Patel: Quick shoutout — huge thanks to @Liam and @Marta for dropping surprise care packages in the kitchen for the oncall shift. little notes + snacks = big smiles :heart:
Liam Chen: Glad everyone liked them! credit to @Sam for sorting addresses and @Devon for the midnight delivery run. :raised_hands:
Sam Rodriguez: happy to help. also massive props to @Priya for jumping on that late-sev fix yesterday — demo would have been rough otherwise.
Priya Nair: ahhh stop, youre gonna make me blush :flushed: but yeah team worked together. shoutout to the infra scripts that kept the retries sane.
ops-bot: Automated note: alert-suppressor v2 engaged at 23:12 — noisy alerts reduced by 87% during the incident window.
Marta Lopez: Facilities also deserves a round — they even put out GF/vegan options and sticky notes. everyone said it felt really thoughtful. :tada:
Devon Walker: the handwritten notes were the best touch. someone wrote a pun about coffee and latency and Im still giggling.
Aisha Patel: can we please do this quarterly? small gestures like this keep morale up during late shifts. quick poll: react with :thumbsup: for quarterly, :raised_hand: for monthly.
Liam Chen: :thumbsup: from me — quarterly feels sustainable and still special.
Sam Rodriguez: :raised_hand: monthly would be rad but might be heavy on budgets; maybe alternate months between treats and team lunch?
Priya Nair: love that compromise. also @Marta  can you loop in facilities to see cost options? (cc: @Liam)
Marta Lopez: yes, I'll put together 2-3 budget-friendly options and drop them here tomorrow.
Devon Walker: Extra thanks to everyone who volunteered deliveries last minute. small teams doing big things. :sparkles:
Aisha Patel: Agree — seriously grateful. tagging this as a win for cross-team care. :heart:
